newsitem.title: FRANCE: French evenly split between govt support,opposition.
newsitem.headline: French evenly split between govt support,opposition.

text.p: The French public is nearly evenly split between backers and adversaries of President Jacques Chirac's centre-right government, according to an opinion poll released on Sunday.

The poll, by the Louis Harris group for the monthly Horizons Politiques, showed 41 percent of those questioned backed the government and 43 percent opposed it. Some 13 percent were neither for nor against while three percent had no opinion.

The poll, for which no direct comparative figures were given, did seem to confirm other indications of rising support for Chirac's government after low ratings for both Chirac and Prime Minister Alain Juppe for much of 1996.
The most recent polls last week showed their popularity was rising for a third consecutive month.
The Louis Harris poll was conducted on March 7-8 among 1,003 people.
